draft.subject: Photographing Roche and Pierre at Carnegie Hall.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw Virgile Roche and Anna Pierre are performing at Carnegie Hall on May 18. I have photographed at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years and shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage that would suit the program. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. Let me know how that lands.
